Welcome to this spacious 4BR apartment in the heart of Reykjavik, offering a perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Just a short walk from top attractions, restaurants, shops, and entertainment, it’s the ideal spot to explore the city before returning to unwind in this beautifully designed and well-equipped retreat.

Key features:

✔ 4 Comfy BRs
✔ Open Design Living
✔ Full Kitchen
✔ Private Patio w/ outdoor sitting
✔ Smart TV
✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi

The space
As soon as you step foot in this spacious apartment, you're greeted by a stylish and exceptionally comfortable living area. The modern design and décor create a welcoming atmosphere, perfectly complementing its fantastic central Reykjavik location.

The fully equipped and 2024 upgraded kitchen and adjacent dining area are where you'll get to prepare and enjoy delicious meals with your loved ones before relaxing in the living room, which sets the stage for memorable evenings. Plenty of natural light comes through the large windows, making the whole home very bright during the entire day, accenting the wooden floors and enhancing the soothing ambiance.

Once the time comes to rest, retreat to four comfortable bedrooms, which feature 5☆-resort comforts that allow you to relax after an exciting day of sightseeing.

Finally, you'll be able to catch some fresh air, relax from the private patio.

There are many options in our apartment, and we can't wait for you to experience them all.

★ LIVING ROOM ★
Step into this spacious and homey living room. Find your place on the comfy sofa, cuddle up with a good book, watch your favorite movie, or gather with your family and friends to discuss your plans for the day.

✔ Comfortable Sofa with Pillows
✔ Sofa can be converted into a bed
✔ 50" Smart TV with Netflix and Youtube

★ KITCHEN & DINING ★
It is fully equipped with stainless-steel cooking appliances that make it suitable for preparing any meal, whether a simple breakfast, a quick snack, or a three-course gourmet dinner. Spacious quartz countertops and a central kitchen island provide plenty of room to work your MasterChef magic.

✔ Stove
✔ Oven
✔ Toaster
✔ Refrigerator/Freezer
✔ Dishwasher
✔ Coffee Maker
✔ Hot Water Kettle
✔ Sink - Hot & Cold Water
✔ Trays
✔ Glasses
✔ Silverware
✔ Pots & Pans

Have a few drinks in the living room while the food is getting ready. Once it's done, serve it at the inviting dining table and enjoy a tasty meal with your loved ones.

✔ Dining Table with Seating for 6
✔ Access to the Patio

★ SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS – 4 BEDROOMS ★
After an unforgettable day of city adventures, you will be looking to rest for an equally entertaining tomorrow. Once you are ready to relax, please make your way to these comfortable bedrooms. 

♛ Master Bedroom: King size bed + Single bed
♛ Bedroom 2: King size bed
♛ Bedroom 3: Double Bed
♛ Bedroom 4: Double Bed
♛ Living room: Sleeping sofa for two

All bedrooms are equipped with a similar set of amenities.

✔ Premium Pillows, Linens, and Sheets
✔ Black-Out Shades
✔ Closets with Hangers and Shelves
✔ Night Stands with Reading Lights


Bathrooms are stocked with fresh towels and essential toiletries, so you don't have to worry about bringing your own. 

✔ Walk-In Shower
✔ Bathtub
✔ Vanity
✔ Mirror
✔ Toilet
✔ Towels
✔ Hair Dryer
✔ Essential Toiletries
✔ Washer/Dryer

In addition to our regular offerings, we are pleased to provide the following baby essentials upon request:

⭐ Baby Crib
Ensure your little one sleeps soundly in our high-quality, safety-tested baby crib.

⭐ High Chair
Keep mealtimes mess-free and comfortable with our modern baby high chair.

We look forward to you finding your happiness in this fantastic apartment. This could mean unplugging for a while, watching a movie, curling up on the sofa with a good book, or enjoying a glass of wine. 

Let us know if you have any questions; we're locals; we have the answers. Happy Travels!

Guest access
The apartment is exclusively yours, without interruption for the duration of your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home. 

Other than the already mentioned amenities, our home also comes with:

✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi
✔ Self Check-In (Lockbox)
✔ Heating
✔ Washer/Dryer
✔ Outdoor sitting

Other things to note
🚭 NO SMOKING INSIDE
 ➞ Please refrain from smoking inside the home. Any evidence of smoking will result in additional fees for odor removal, duct cleaning, and furniture cleaning.

🎉NO PARTIES OR EVENTS
  ➞ We kindly ask that you treat our home with care and respect to help maintain its pristine condition for future guests and your return visits. All noise-related complaints will be taken very seriously.

🕒 CHECK-IN & CHECK-OUT
Check-in: 3:00 PM & Check-out: 11:00 AM
